ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel field across approximately 85% of visible surface, with high-intensity (white) clusters restricted to the distal tips and peripheral edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black field across both lobes. High-contrast white mottling and solid banding concentrated on the far-left lateral margin and tip. Sparse, high-intensity white punctate spots are distributed across the black field of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged serrations along the upper boundary of both lobes. The left lobe exhibits more pronounced, irregular peaks (approximately 5-8 pixel-amplitude) compared to the right lobe's smoother, lower-frequency variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve extending upward and outward from the submerged peduncle towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-contrast white and tan clusters indicative of biological encrustation concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) traversing the lower-mid section of the left fluke lobe, primarily oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) on the left lobe and heavy barnacle colonization/scarring at the distal fluke tips.
